en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with old houses and stone walls in a historic European town. The street curves gently and leads toward taller multi‑story buildings with steep gabled roofs. On the hill above stands a large medieval complex with a steep roof and tower, and in the background a church or castle tower with a dome and spire is visible. The image has a white border with handwritten-style captions at the bottom.
